game_concept: A action defense set in Snowy Hold – Wolf Watch, a lookout against wolves: the snow ranger must handle icicle bats while practicing functions. Core idea – Docstring Detective: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case.
theme: Snowy Hold – Wolf Watch: a lookout against wolves
core_gameplay_loop: In Wolf Watch, repeat each round: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case. Each round, icicle bats strike the watch bell, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the cases value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the watch bell from icicle bats in Wolf Watch: keep the cases meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: cases drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Docstring Detective
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Docstring Detective' (Week 6 slot 9), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Wolf Watch'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cases changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against icicle bats in Wolf Watch.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while cases > 0.
